title: Have an approved club secretary
what: Appoint as the club's secretary only a person approved as its secretary.

sources.title: Registered Clubs Act 1976 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A registered club must not appoint a person to act as the secretary of the club unless the person is the approved secretary of the club.
